purposeContract.audience: The owner evaluating a future personal hardware-and-agent experiment.
purposeContract.outcome: Test whether physical presence, perception, and local intelligence create value beyond a screen-based assistant.
purposeContract.mechanism: The proposed system joins Apple-device perception, local AI, and an ESP32-class embodied platform in bounded experiments.
purposeContract.proof: Only ideation and planning are retained; there is no completed hardware build or public product today.
purposeContract.nextAction: No action is currently available; reopen only after an explicit hardware purchase and a bounded Phase 0 experiment.

forecast-lab.makerNote: I wanted to learn forecasting by modeling how regional, temporal, and behavioral signals shape commerce demand.

purposeContract.purpose: Forecast Lab is an evaluation-first learning environment for modeling how regional, temporal, and behavioral signals shape commerce demand.
purposeContract.audience: A practitioner learning forecasting methods with bounded datasets and explicit evaluation.
purposeContract.outcome: Understand which signals improve a forecast and where the model fails, without pretending to offer a proven consulting product.
purposeContract.mechanism: Rust, Python, and web experiments compare forecasting approaches against held-out data and visible metrics.
purposeContract.proof: The research toolkit supports concrete experiments, but lacks the proprietary data and domain validation required for credible B2B claims.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use it for a specific learning or evaluation question; do not treat the held lab as an active consulting service.

web-playables.makerNote: I built this laboratory to understand how idle and HTML-based games are designed, shipped, and distributed.

purposeContract.purpose: Web Playables is a small laboratory for learning how browser and YouTube-ready games are designed, packaged, and distributed.
purposeContract.audience: A builder studying reusable HTML5 game mechanics and portable distribution constraints.
purposeContract.outcome: Prototype a mechanic once and ship it as a normal web game and a submission-ready playable package.
purposeContract.mechanism: A reusable gamekit supplies loops, saves, offline progress, platform adapters, and builds for a small games hub.
purposeContract.proof: The research goal produced a working gamekit, a live idle game, and YouTube-compatible packaging; the project is now parked.
purposeContract.nextAction: Play the retained game or inspect the kit; add another game only when a specific mechanic is worth studying.

what-it-takes-to-win.makerNote: I wanted to study the real advantages behind success and replace unhelpful comparison with evidence-based understanding.

purposeContract.purpose: What It Takes to Win shows why visible success cannot be reduced to a simple formula or a fair comparison with your own path.
purposeContract.audience: Readers who turn another person’s visible outcome into a judgment about their own pace, ability, or worth.
purposeContract.outcome: Replace flattened comparison with a more humane, evidence-bounded understanding of conditions, sequence, perseverance, and luck.
purposeContract.mechanism: A guided research exhibit connects source-linked life events and early-breakthrough paths through what people brought, were handed, and were surrounded by.
purposeContract.proof: The publication contains thousands of documented early-breakthrough paths, visible methodology, and ongoing source-linked profile coverage.
purposeContract.nextAction: Complete the guided comparison-futility journey, then inspect the underlying profiles, sources, and coverage.

sarthakagrawal-personal.makerNote: I maintain a personal website because I need one durable, accurate public record of my work and professional identity.

purposeContract.purpose: Sarthak Agrawal’s personal site is the durable public record of his work, writing, résumé, and professional identity.
purposeContract.audience: People evaluating Sarthak as an AI infrastructure and product engineer, collaborator, or builder.
purposeContract.outcome: Understand what he works on, what he has built, and how to verify or contact him.
purposeContract.mechanism: A maintained portfolio connects current positioning to selected projects, writing, résumé evidence, and public profiles.
purposeContract.proof: The public site is complete and satisfactory as the canonical professional record; updates follow changes in the underlying work.
purposeContract.nextAction: Explore the current work and résumé or use the listed contact paths; do not infer stale focus areas from older copy.

agent-office.makerNote: I wanted to explore a company where humans and non-coding agents each own outcomes and keep working toward them over time.

purposeContract.purpose: Office OS gives a small-organization owner a persistent Mac workplace for hiring, directing, and supervising named AI employees.
purposeContract.audience: An owner who wants useful non-technical AI employees without managing prompts, workflows, or agent infrastructure directly.
purposeContract.outcome: Delegate bounded responsibilities, see progress and blockers, review artifacts, intervene safely, and resume work across days.
purposeContract.mechanism: Named employees have durable roles, memory, workspaces, skills, scoped authority, and inspectable outcome loops inside a local organization folder.
purposeContract.proof: A credible local proof of concept can run a bounded writer-manager workday, but differentiation and recurring owner use remain unproven.
purposeContract.nextAction: Review the local proof; reopen product investment only after comparing strong alternatives and proving one recurring workflow.

local-ai-video-studio.makerNote: I wanted editing intent to choose efficient local video tools before defaulting to expensive generative video.

purposeContract.purpose: Local AI Video Studio helps a creator compare reproducible local video effects before choosing and exporting a result.
purposeContract.audience: A Mac-based creator who wants deterministic editing options before paying for generative video.
purposeContract.outcome: Translate an editing intention into visible effect variants and choose a result that can be reproduced.
purposeContract.mechanism: A native Mac studio uses AVFoundation, Core Image, and hardware video tools to render comparable local variants from one source.
purposeContract.proof: The bounded local experiment works, but owner interest faded before a recurring creator workflow was established.
purposeContract.nextAction: Treat it as a held local experiment; reopen only around a real creator job where deterministic effects clearly help.

field-track.makerNote: I started Field Track for my father: a lower-cost way for managers to locate employees carrying administrator-enrolled Android devices and review retained routes.

purposeContract.purpose: Field Track is an administrator-managed field-location system for continuously enrolled Android devices and freshness-aware route review.
purposeContract.audience: A small field team and its manager, initially the owner’s father’s business.
purposeContract.outcome: Let a manager find employees quickly and review retained routes while managed tracking remains visible on each Android device.
purposeContract.mechanism: An administrator-enrolled Android app captures points continuously, queues them through weak 4G, and sends them to a team-scoped dashboard where server policy controls retention.
purposeContract.proof: A clearly labeled synthetic-data dashboard and bounded MVP path exist; economics and physical Android testing remain unresolved.
purposeContract.nextAction: Review the synthetic demo as a held MVP; validate business economics and a real Android device before expanding or onboarding a team.

field-track.description: A private field-location system for managed Android devices and team-scoped route review.

reddit-insights.makerNote: I wanted to understand how the signals and emotions inside a subreddit change over time, even though historical data is difficult to obtain.

purposeContract.purpose: Reddit Insights studies how topics, signals, and emotional tone inside a subreddit change over time.
purposeContract.audience: A researcher or product operator following a specific community longitudinally.
purposeContract.outcome: Recognize recurring shifts and emerging concerns from a retained body of subreddit evidence.
purposeContract.mechanism: A bounded collector stores attributable snapshots and derives recurring insight views without claiming unavailable history.
purposeContract.proof: The collector and snapshot model exist, but reliable lawful access to historical Reddit data remains the central blocker.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use it for forward collection or retained snapshots; historical claims must wait for a lawful dependable source.

reddit-insights.description: A bounded research collector for subreddit evidence and recurring insight snapshots.

verified-bases.makerNote: I explored whether the native codebases I already build could become inexpensive, verified templates for other makers.

purposeContract.purpose: Verified Bases tested whether proven iOS and Mac codebases could be packaged as inexpensive, inspectable starter templates.
purposeContract.audience: Independent makers who value verified product foundations, ownership, and optional launch help over raw generated code.
purposeContract.outcome: Start from a reviewed native base with clearer quality and delivery expectations.
purposeContract.mechanism: A proposed storefront paired curated code packages with previews, verification, ownership, fulfilment, and optional assistance.
purposeContract.proof: The marketplace and fulfilment prototype was archived before paid checkout or any catalogue listing proved buyer demand.
purposeContract.nextAction: Read the retained research identity only; there is no active store or purchasable template until demand and support economics are validated.

verified-bases.description: A retained research-data identity with no retained local Git history or standalone public destination.

anchor.makerNote: I wanted a realistic daily planner that could help me follow the day and explain why the lived plan diverged from the intended one.

purposeContract.purpose: Anchor helps a person plan a realistic day, follow the current intention, and learn why the day lived differed from the day planned.
purposeContract.audience: A person moving between Mac, iPhone, and Apple Watch who wants a deliberate day rather than another task list.
purposeContract.outcome: Make more realistic plans, recover from interruptions, and protect activities that genuinely matter without moralizing imperfect adherence.
purposeContract.mechanism: Native apps combine schedule blocks, recurring routines, wall-clock focus sessions, interruption evidence, and an end-of-day divergence review.
purposeContract.proof: The maintained successor to Indulge and Habits has signed native builds and an integrated schedule → focus → interruption → review loop under dogfooding.
purposeContract.nextAction: Use Anchor through a real day and review the divergence evidence; let repeated lived patterns decide the next change.
